notes.title: Nine years after release: New update for Gold Rush! Anniversary” released!
notes.content:
More than nine years after the last update, Sunlight Games has released a new update for “Gold Rush! Anniversary”. The update fixes small issues and was released on Steam for PC.

Changelog of all fixes in version 1.15:
- Engine updated to a latest version.
- Saving was developed completely new. For using old save games, a converter was developed, which check at the game start if there are old save games. If so, they will be backuped and then converted. If the converted save games are making problems, please start a thread in the forum, then we can convert your old ones (backuped), you then send to us. Until now, converted save-games didn’t make any problems in all tests.
- The new save games have endings and we fixed the problem in the directory with the possible added file by Steam, Cloud Save should work again in the future. In a while we will make it available again!
- Bug in parser fixed, when Jerrod gets stuck from going from harbor into direction of the bank.
- Some artworks were better trimmed in a few the scenes.
- Some collisions were optimized in a few scenes.
- Some layer problems were fixed in a few scenes.
- The mouse-cursor is now kept in the game-screen.
- After changing from P&C to parser and back, sometimes the mouse cursor was not in the menu, fixed!

A detailed list can be found in the Steam-forum!

notes.title: New update to Gold Rush! Anniversary” announced!
notes.content:
More than nine years after the last update, Sunlight Games has announced a new update for “Gold Rush! Anniversary”. The update fixes small issues. It will first be soon released for PC on Steam and later also for iOS and Android. The update will also be released for all users who own the box version.

The exact improvements will be announced with the release.

In addition, another update is in development that will add new features to the game.


Sunlight Games' Marco Sowa-Israel about the update: "Gold Rush! Anniversary has always been a special game for us. Preparing an update for this now after more than 9 years since its release is absolutely great. Even if the update only fixes small issues, it was still a lot of work, as adapting to the latest version of the engine involved a lot of work. The plan is to release more features soon.”

tags.bug: The update fixes small issues.

tags.feature: In addition, another update is in development that will add new features to the game.
The plan is to release more features soon.”

notes.title: Gold Rush! 2 update to 1.0.3 released for PC!
notes.content:

Here is the changelog:

- The texts for the robbery in the train was changed
- fixed some layer problems
- added small graphics
- fixed small issues
- fixed problems taking the dynamite, climbing the pole and speaking to the officer, on some few resolutions

notes.title: Gold Rush! Anniversary version 1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Gold Rush! Anniversary version 1.1 is now available. Patch notes below.

[h1]Fixed in 1.1:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Parser: Added more rude commands from the original
    [*]Parser: Added more content views
    [*]Performance improvements
    [*]File size improvements
    [*]Fixed small text issues
    [*]More sounds added
    [*]A few change scenes improved
    [*]Added more interactions with objects
    [*]Added more idle animations for characters and animals
    [*]Fixed an issue in the bank of Brooklyn
    [*]Added information of reached points
    [*]Fixed a few minor issues with waypoints and descriptions
    [*]Fixed a crash in one of the last scenes, which occurs rarely
    [*]Added many new translations
    [*]Fixed bug with cutoff legs near of Coloma
    [*]Fixed bug with double click behind the edge in wilderness between Sutter's Fort and Coloma
    [*]Fixed minor issues in Brooklyn
    [*]Mac: Fixed the rescale/resolution issue in full screen and window-mode
[/list]

[h1]Fixed previous:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed small graphics issues
    [*]Fixed quest on the Cape Horn Trek
    [*]Fixed conversation with mule seller in Sutter's Fort
    [*]Fixed control between Sutter's Fort and Coloma
    [*]Parser: Added rude commands as in the original
[/list]

Version 1.1 ist nun verfügbar. Unten sind gibt es Informationen zum Patch.

[h1]Behebungen in 1.1:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Kommandozeile: weitere raue Befehle (wie im Original) hinzugefügt
    [*]Kommandozeile: Weitere Inhaltsansichten
    [*]Geschwindigkeit-Verbesserungen
    [*]Dateigrößen-Optimierungen
    [*]Kleine Textfehler behoben
    [*]Weitere Soundeffekte eingefügt
    [*]Ein paar Szenenwechsel optimiert
    [*]Weitere Interaktionen mit Objekten hinzugefügt
    [*]Weitere Leerlauf-Animationen für Charaktere und Tier hinzugefügt
    [*]Kleines Problem in der Bank behoben
    [*]Informationen über erreichte Punkte hinzugefügt
    [*]Kleine Probleme mit Wegpunkten und Beschreibungen wurden behoben
    [*]Ein seltener Absturz in einer der letzten Szenen wurde behoben
    [*]Viele weitere Übersetzungen wurden hinzugefügt
    [*]Der Fehler mit den abgeschnittenen Beinen bei Coloma wurde behoben
    [*]Ein Fehler mit dem Doppelklick hinter dem Rand, der in der Wildnis zwischen Sutter's Fort und Coloma auftrat wurde behoben
    [*]Unschönheiten in Brooklyn behoben
    [*]Mac: Auflösungs-/Skalierungsprobleme im Vollbild- und Fenstermodus behoben
[/list]

[h1]Vorher bereits behoben:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Kleine Grafikfehler behoben
    [*]Ein Quest auf der Kap Horn-Route behoben
    [*]Konversation mit dem Mule-Verkäufer in Sutter's Fort behoben
    [*]Steuerung zwischen Sutter's Fort und Coloma behoben
    [*]Kommandozeile: Raue Befehle (wie im Original) hinzugefügt
[/list]
